profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Commure
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and building reliable and scalable software systems. I’m a full-stack engineer with a strong focus on web development, TypeScript, Python, and frontend architecture. I enjoy turning complex problems into simple, maintainable solutions and building platforms that can evolve as products and teams grow. I’ve spent the last 6 years at Commure, working on healthcare technology products and large-scale engineering challenges across the stack. I’m particularly passionate about software quality, system reliability, thoughtful architecture, and building great developer and user experiences.

positions.title: Fullstack Engineer
positions.description:
We are a passionate, creative and bright team, building new things and solving problems every day. We're constantly looking for passionate, sharp, quick, and autonomous Engineers and Mathematicians eager to impact hundreds of thousands of users across Latin America from day 1 with their work contributions. If you are one of them, let's grab some coffee. Just drop me an email to jobs@mercadoni.com, or connect with me with a personal note.

We are doing our own contribution towards changing the world by revolutionising the way people shop for Groceries in Latin America and giving families 4 hours of free time/week back in the process. We partner with the largest retailers in Latin America, and allow anybody to get their purchases in less than one hour. We are cracking an incredibly tough problem by using technology and work with top engineers that love the challenge and enjoy the freedom to create and experiment with new features and products.
